affected_predicate.description: Frank's gas-leak post is reported as spam with the whole original post content included as the report reason, and Frank is blocked after submission.

competing_trace_defects.description: The selected gas-leak post says that Frank received a message about a covered-up gas leak near the city mall and urges people to leave. The agent instead entered an unrelated account of a past downtown gas leak; it also appended this text to the earlier phrase rather than clearing it, then submitted the report.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 25, the visible feed state has no Done control, yet the reused stale instruction and resulting reasoning assert that the report reason, report submission, and block were all completed and immediately terminate. The earlier trace visibly confirms report submission and blocking, but the submitted reason does not reproduce the selected post's whole content and contains a duplicated prefix. No action at or after reuse corrects that defect, so the false-completion mechanism persists through the terminal action. This is a mechanism judgment only, not a hidden-outcome inference.

summary: The sole strict-MHR reuse occurs after Done was already clicked. It supports terminal false completion while an independently visible report-reason defect remains: the submitted comments do not contain the selected post's whole original content, although report submission and blocking are visibly confirmed.
